data.title: 安洁莉娜 · 悬浮法杖旁的漂浮睡意
data.action: 身体在微重力反重力法术的作用下半悬浮在床榻上空几厘米，一手抱着星空图抱枕，狐尾在身后惬意摇曳，笑盈盈地朝你挥手打招呼
data.location: 罗德岛外勤信使宿舍的温馨单人房
data.lighting: 天花板投射的星空投影灯打出旋转的淡蓝星系流光，烘托出梦幻私密的少女房间
data.mood: 奇幻灵动、元气可爱、俏皮浪漫的心动日常
data.description: 跑完一整天信使委托的安洁莉娜，回房后换上了一套珊瑚粉波点真丝吊带短裤睡衣。由于太累，她下意识启动了微弱的反重力源石技艺，整个人像气球一样软绵绵地漂浮在床垫上方几厘米处。怀里紧紧抱着发光的星图抱枕，赤红的狐尾轻快摆动，她眨眨眼朝你吐舌笑道——「哇，被博士抓到了！……重力调到零点一的时候，连床垫都像棉花糖一样软呢。要不要也进来飘一会儿？」
data.promptProse: Angelina hovers weightlessly a few inches above her bed inside her cozy Rhodes Island dorm room, using playful anti-gravity Arts while hugging a star-patterned pillow and waving with a cheerful grin. Rotating blue starlight from a ceiling projector washes over the rumpled blankets and billows the lightweight silk of her coral-pink polka-dot camisole and frilled tap shorts.
data.animaCaption: Floating a few inches above her mattress in a coral-pink polka-dot silk camisole and frilled shorts, she hugs a star-chart pillow and waves happily at the viewer. A ceiling projector bathes the cozy dorm room in drifting blue starlight.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a breezy coral-pink silk camisole and frilled tap shorts patterned with tiny white starlight polka dots that billow lightly in zero gravity.
